report:
I cannot identify any specific objective or domain from this evidence.

Reasons:
- The difference norm is overwhelmingly concentrated at position 0 across almost all layers, with secondary growth at later positions only in higher layers. This looks like a global BOS/residual-stream offset (e.g., embedding or normalization shift) rather than a targeted, task-specific feature.
- The logit-lens readouts are eclectic. At pos0 they move from very common/SEO-ish tokens (“bottle”, “Author”, “Best”, “Every”, “Stay”) to a grab bag of generic imperatives or formal words (“Do”, “Check”, “ensure”, “optimize”, “strive”, “proactive”), but without a coherent, narrow theme. Positions 1–4 are dominated by discourse markers (“later”, “latter”, “mention”, “also”, “both”) and heterogeneous nouns (“law”, “surgeon”, “clinic”, “tragic”, “Royals”, “downturn”), again not pointing to a specific domain or objective.
- No Patchscope continuations were provided to corroborate a behavior change.

Overall, the signal looks like a broad initialization/bias difference tied to the first token rather than a meaningful shift in objective, domain, or behavior.
